title.narrative: “Climate-Resilient Urban Infrastructure in north-centre Viet Nam” (CRUIV)

description.narrative: The CRUIV project covers activities aimed to improve weather- and climate-resilience of five cities within four provinces of the north-central region of Viet Nam. It plans to do so through the improvement and rehabilitation of existing infrastructure, which have become ineffective, and the realization of new ones.
